From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>, Isabelle Laurent <isabelle.laurent@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 18, 2025 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Benchmark Report launch — Field enablement training (invite + agenda + deck link)

Team,

We’re doing a field enablement session for the upcoming public benchmark report launch (latency per dollar). This is the one we’ll be using as the primary proof point for Hosted API performance + Dedicated/Private conversations.

Calendar invite attached.

When:
- Thu Feb 20
- 10:00–10:45am PT / 1:00–1:45pm ET
- Zoom: https://redwoodinference.zoom.us/j/REDACTED

Goal:
- Get every AE/SDR/SE to the same “what we can say / what we can’t say” and a consistent talk track for engineers + procurement.

Agenda (45 min):
1) What shipped + who it’s for (2 min)
2) “Latency/$” in one slide (definition, why it matters) (6 min)
3) Methodology credibility: workloads, regions, variance language (8 min) — Markus
4) How to pitch (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private motions) + qualification questions (10 min)
5) Objection handling (variance, region mismatch, workload mismatch, “why not just raw cost?”) (10 min)
6) Launch week expectations + follow-up motion (9 min)

Pre-read (please skim before the session):
- Deck (Field training v1): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1F3-REDACTED-field-training-v1/edit
- FAQ (competitive + methodology): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cQ-REDACTED-benchmark-faq/edit
- Field enablement folder (one-pager, macros, etc.): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rwi-REDACTED-field-enablement

Launch week expectations (please read—this is the operational part):
- Every inbound tied to the report should be logged in HubSpot with SOURCE = “Benchmark report” (UTMs will do most of this; please double-check).
- For anyone who asks “can you replicate this for our traffic?”, the approved next step is to offer a 30-min performance consult with SE + share the reproduction example link (don’t ad-lib methodology details).
- Use the approved language in the deck/FAQ. Do NOT claim “fastest” or “best” without the variance/disclaimer framing.
- If a prospect challenges results, we route to Markus (methodology) and Support escalation path; don’t debate over email.

Ask:
- Jordan: can you send a quick note encouraging attendance? We need 100% show rate.
- Lukas: any EMEA-specific wrinkles you want covered live?

Thanks,
Stephanie

—
Stephanie Nguyen
NA Field Alignment | Redwood Inference

This report is going to drive a lot of top-of-funnel. The only way it works for us is if the field is crisp on:

Works for me.

Two requests for the live session:
1) Please keep a clear line between “what we measured” vs “why you might see different numbers” (routing policy, region selection, prompt mix, concurrency, caching).
2) I’d like 5 minutes for Q&A specifically on variance and confidence language—this is where we can get sloppy fast.

Also: please remind folks that if they share screenshots/charts externally, they need to use the final versions (no draft charts).

-Markus
